summary: Admin Portal FASE 2 (Estructura Académica) testing completed. All features working: Academic Structure page with tabs for Years, Levels, Grades, Sections, and Shifts. CRUD operations verified. Fixed frontend bug where 'planificado' status was used instead of 'futuro' for academic years.
passed_tests: Admin login (admin@test.pe / test123) redirects to /school/demosettings/admin
Owner/director login (admin.settings@test.pe / test123) redirects to /school/demosettings/dashboard (NOT admin portal)
Navigation to /admin/academic-structure via sidebar works
Academic Structure page loads with correct title and tabs
Tab 'Años Académicos' shows 2 years (2026 Activo, 2025 Cerrado)
Tab 'Niveles' shows 3 levels (Inicial, Primaria, Secundaria)
Tab 'Grados' shows 14 grades organized by level
Tab 'Secciones' shows 16 sections with grade and capacity info
Tab 'Turnos' shows 3 shifts (Mañana, Tarde, Noche) with time ranges
Create new level via modal works correctly
API GET /api/academic/years returns 200 with year list
API GET /api/academic/levels returns 200 with level list
API GET /api/academic/grades returns 200 with grade list
API GET /api/academic/sections returns 200 with section list
API GET /api/academic/shifts returns 200 with shift list
API POST /api/academic/levels creates new level successfully
API PUT /api/academic/levels/{id} updates level successfully
API POST /api/academic/shifts creates new shift successfully
API POST /api/academic/years creates new year successfully
Owner/director user can read all academic data (backend allows)
Owner/director user can create academic levels (is_admin_user allows director role)
critical_code_review_comments: Frontend correctly uses isAdminOnly(user) to restrict admin portal to role='admin' only
Backend is_admin_user() allows owner, admin, and director roles for CRUD operations
Academic Structure page properly fetches data from all 5 endpoints on load
Tab navigation works correctly with state management
CRUD modals have proper form validation
data-testid attributes present on key elements for testing
seed_data_creation: Using existing data: 2 academic years, 3 levels, 14 grades, 16 sections, 3 shifts. Created test level 'TEST_Nivel_Playwright' during UI testing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Admin Portal FASE 2 (Estructura Académica) is fully functional. The page has 5 tabs: Años Académicos, Niveles, Grados, Secciones, Turnos. Admin user (admin@test.pe) has role='admin' and can access admin portal. Owner user (admin.settings@test.pe) has role='director' and is correctly redirected to regular dashboard.
